units.source_text: 于是，我做了说明，让他明白他的解释反而只能加深大家对我的猜疑。

en.t: So I explained, making him understand that his explanation would only deepen everyone’s suspicions of me.

units.source_text: 我说，只要老师知道我是无辜的，其他的一切就可以不问了。

en.t: I said that as long as the teacher knew I was innocent, nothing else needed to be asked.

units.source_text: 说话的时候，我心里露出了几分喜悦。

en.t: As I spoke, a certain joy showed itself in my heart.

units.source_text: 喜悦逐渐牢固地扎下了根。

en.t: That joy gradually took firm root.

units.source_text: 这是"没有目击者、没有见证人"的喜悦……

en.t: It was the joy of having no eyewitnesses and no witnesses at all...
